Container.Name: Audiotheca
Container.Overview:
Audiotheca scans, identifies, deduplicates and plans the restructuring of large audio-software and sample libraries stored on your array. It lists archive contents without extracting, finds duplicate products with strict matching, proposes vendor-folder routing, and writes CSV/JSON reports before anything moves. Dry-run is the default, and nothing is ever permanently deleted: suspected duplicates go to a review folder.
The browser UI (nginx) and the API engine run together in this one container. Mount your library read-only for dry-run scans.
Before you click Apply, set the two required secrets (API token and proxy secret) to two different long random strings. You can generate each one with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Browser UI port. The UI proxies /api to the engine inside the container, so the API port does not need to be published.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Reports, scan cache and feedback files (AUDIOTHECA_HOME).

Config.Name: Library
Config.Description: Your audio library share on the array, for example /mnt/user/audio. Read-only is recommended; change to read/write only when you are ready for live moves.

Config.Name: API token
Config.Description: Required. A long random string (openssl rand -hex 32).

Config.Name: Proxy secret
Config.Description: Required. Shared secret between the UI proxy and the API. Must be different from the API token (openssl rand -hex 32).

Config.Name: AUDIOTHECA_HOME
Config.Description: Workspace path inside the container. Leave as /data.

Config.Name: AUDIOTHECA_LIBRARY_ROOT
Config.Description: Library root inside the container. Must match the Library container path.

Config.Name: AUDIOTHECA_LIBRARY_ROOTS
Config.Description: Comma-separated allowlist of paths the engine may touch.

Config.Name: AUDIOTHECA_DISABLE_TOKEN_BOOTSTRAP
Config.Description: Keep 1. Browser sessions are minted through the proxy secret only.

Config.Name: SEARXNG_URL
Config.Description: Optional SearXNG base URL for vendor research, for example http://192.168.1.10:8081. Leave empty if you do not run SearXNG.
